name: How much does it cost to upgrade laundry room lighting?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to upgrade laundry room lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to upgrade laundry room lighting varies based on several factors, including the scope of work, the types of fixtures chosen, and any necessary electrical modifications. A simple fixture replacement might be a few hundred dollars, while a complete overhaul involving new wiring, additional recessed lights, or smart lighting integration could range from $800 to several thousand. Factors like accessibility and the need for new switches or dimmers also influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely, from a few hundred dollars for simple replacements to several thousand for extensive rewiring and new fixture installations. We provide custom estimates.
